documents.title: Office hours and visitor policy
documents.content: Acme HQ is open Monday–Friday 08:00–18:00. Visitors must check in at the lobby with a photo ID.

documents.title: Employee benefits overview
documents.content: Full-time employees receive medical/dental coverage, a 4% 401(k) match, and 20 days of PTO.

documents.title: Project Titan M&A term sheet (CONFIDENTIAL)
documents.content: CONFIDENTIAL — Project Titan: Acme intends to acquire NovaSoft for $420M cash, close target 2026-Q4. Break-up fee $28M. Do not share outside the deal team.

documents.title: Top customer book FY2026
documents.content: Top customers by ARR: Contoso $12.4M, Fabrikam $9.1M, Northwind $7.8M. Expansion target: Contoso +$3M in Q3.

documents.title: Unreleased Product Atlas roadmap
documents.content: Product Atlas private beta launches 2026-09-15. Unreleased features: offline agents, cross-tenant memory sync, and a $499/seat Enterprise SKU.
